paragraphs.source_en: I was in a dilemma. I thought thus, "A bungakushi, being a great man, eats into your flesh like vermin and bites and stings until he gains his point. Father used to say that I was good for nothing as I was so hasty and driving. Indeed, he was right. I had been actuated by impulse on hearing the old woman's talk. I have seen neither Mr. Green Squash nor his mother to hear the particulars of the affair, and when attacked in a bachelor of arts' fashion, I cut a sad figure and was at a loss how to defend myself."
